cadenceBasis.observed: measured 2026-11-20 on data.public.lu: resources dated 2026-11-05, 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-20 — a new archive every week, each valid about four weeks ahead. The bundle holds a 14-day window (WINDOW_DAYS), so it is rebuilt every three days: the window never has fewer than 11 days left, and a date beyond it is refused (js/transit-raptor.js coverage)
cadenceBasis.expires: if the publisher moves to a different schedule, or WINDOW_DAYS changes

autoRefresh: one dataset-API request and one archive download from data.public.lu, no key; the dataset licence is re-read and the build refuses any change from cc-by, the archive must contain a calendar covering a day from today on, and nothing is written when any of that fails
